note: No model or dataset download is needed to build or run: the activation captures are assets. The Judge-only final suite enters only the host-built Judge layer (images/judge/Dockerfile.private); the 139 scored real layers (judge/real_layers/, about 58 GB) are never part of an image: scripts/sforge_judge_entry.py mounts them read-only into every Judge container. The two public real layers enter only the host-built Work layer (images/work/Dockerfile.local); the published Work and public Judge images carry the e8 capture and no real-layer capture. Licenses of the captures (derived activations of the named models and data) are listed per asset; public/licenses/ holds the NOTICE and model licenses. The recipe scripts under fixtures/recipe/ can re-capture any of them.
